result.baseline: Before source-level repair, freeze a deterministic stable-order selector over a small named set of actively tested public Python repositories, excluding every repository previously used by O repair trials. Bind exactly one eligible open regression, repository and issue identity, license, exact source commit, selected paths, environment, dependency resolution, commands, budgets, rubric, and solution-access exclusions. In a pristine local checkout reproduce the reported failure before authoring at most one minimal patch; run the unchanged focused and strongest feasible official tests. Report PASS, FAIL, NOT_EVALUABLE, or UNCERTAIN without target substitution and with zero upstream writes.

cost_dimensions.external: Zero external mutations, comments, pull requests, releases, deployments, paid services, or secret-dependent actions.
cost_dimensions.failure_risk: Fail closed without substitution when provenance, reproduction, contamination, safety, budget, or official-test conditions are not satisfied.
cost_dimensions.latency: One repository, one regression, one patch attempt, and the strongest feasible bounded test subset.
cost_dimensions.quality: Prospective selection, pristine reproduction, one minimal patch, official tests, exact replay, and explicit negative scope.
cost_dimensions.token: No token-level, generalized, or AGI inference is authorized.
cost_dimensions.tool: Read-only public GitHub observation, one clean local checkout, local test tools, and protected O publication only.

result.reason: No indexed Candidate is verified for this exact cross-project first-attempt regression-repair transfer trial. The unchanged Execute component and the prospectively frozen selector/baseline protocol preserve interpretable evidence and the no-solution-access boundary.
regression_checks: exactly one previously unused repository family and one regression are selected before solution or patch access
the locked baseline reproduces in a pristine checkout before the sole patch attempt
the patch touches only justified paths and the focused failure is removed for PASS
all frozen required official tests pass and no protected regression is observed for PASS
no target, command, rubric, budget, dependency, or contamination boundary changes after outcome visibility
no upstream write, Candidate activation, generalized capability claim, user-completion claim, or AGI claim occurs
result.rollback: On non-unique selection, missing provenance or license, solution contamination, nonreproducing baseline, dependency drift, unsafe or secret-dependent tests, budget exhaustion, patch failure, or official regression: preserve the exact bounded artifacts, report the precommitted non-PASS verdict, make no Candidate or route change, do not substitute another target, and perform no upstream write.
